news_items.headline: Aberdeen v Rangers: Pick of the stats
news_items.summary: Rangers manager Derek McInnes has lost five of his past six away league games against former side Aberdeen, including the latest three in a row since a 1-0 win with Kilmarnock in December 2023.  Rangers could fail to win their opening three games of a league season for the second successive campaign (drawing three in 2025-26).  Aberdeen have won four of their past five home league games (losing the other), including their first this season, 2-1 over Hearts.
